question:
The requirement is to use a dynamic variable in posthook, I just don't know if its possible in dbt model

example :
title: can we use dynamic variable in DBT models
answer:
Move your set variable to top.

Then append the variable name in posthook using ~

e.g.

{% set var1 = 1 %}

{{
    config(
        ...,
        post_hook = "update table set column = 0 where col1 = " ~ var1
    )
}}
